# Who implements each declared protocol, for tests/test_declared_holdbacks.py and scripts/surface_kinds.py (which reads
# a protocol's kind from it). One `<name> | <reason>` per line, sorted. Whether a declared name is used at all
# (admission criterion 2) is read from code, never listed here: tests/test_declared_holdbacks.py says what counts.
#
#   port-host-implements      A declared protocol a host's code implements and hands the engine.
#   protocol-engine-provides  A declared protocol the engine implements and hands a host's code, or that the engine's
#                             own storage satisfies over the host's store.
#   unreached                 Declared, and used by nothing. None.
#
# History: computed 2026-11-06 at a3f15bfd8, with a discodon-tests-only reason for names only Discodon's tests imported
# (all of them made provisional that day, R5). 2026-11-15 (package V): CassetteStore, DefinitionStore and
# RunRecordStore demoted, and the discodon-tests-only reason deleted, since a test alone never holds a name.
threetears.evals.kernel.ActionSeam | port-host-implements
threetears.evals.kernel.CandidateKind | port-host-implements
threetears.evals.kernel.CellCassettes | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.CellSink | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.CellSpanWindow | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.DeliveryRecorder | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.DeliveryReplay | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.DeliverySeam | port-host-implements
threetears.evals.kernel.DeliveryTicket | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.JobStore | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.Recordable | port-host-implements
threetears.evals.kernel.ResultStore | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.RunStore | protocol-engine-provides
threetears.evals.kernel.host.CompletionClients | port-host-implements
threetears.evals.kernel.host.TemplateCaseFields | protocol-engine-provides
